analysis.decision_ci: two-sided 95% percentile interval for each paired risk difference

planned_confirmatory_design.decision_rule: PACT_BENEFIT_ESTABLISHED requires positive PACT-ACT and PACT-PACT_ZERO point differences, both paired-bootstrap 95% lower bounds above zero, and both two-sided Fisher p-values below 0.05. PACT_WORSE_THAN_ACT requires the PACT-ACT paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound below zero and two-sided Fisher p<0.05. A reconciled experiment not meeting either rule is PACT_NO_CONFIRMED_BENEFIT. Any unreconciled scheduled row is PACT_EXPERIMENT_INCOMPLETE.
planned_confirmatory_design.power_statement: With 80 observations per arm, a conservative equal-n independent-proportions normal approximation has 80% power at two-sided alpha=0.05 for about a 21.6 percentage-point increase from a 50% ACT baseline. Pairing may improve precision but is not credited in this planning number.
